bio_en: Mihran Tiriakian, known as Vahan, was born on 2 February 1871 in the village of Derevank near Kayseri; with little schooling he educated himself and worked as a carpenter. He joined the revolutionary movement in Constantinople in 1888, took part in the Bab-i Ali demonstration and, unable to remain in the capital, went abroad. Returning to the fight, he served as a squad leader and fell in the Khastur battle on the Russo-Turkish border, as reported by Droshak in March 1900. He was the brother of Khan (Barsegh Tiriakian).
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Year of death inferred from the March 1900 obituary and the date of the Khastur fight (26 October).
